title: 2004 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: Ms. Hamilton’s eighth-grade class wants to participate in the annual three-person-team basketball tournament. Lance, Sally, Joy, and Fred are chosen for the team. In how many ways can the three starters be chosen?

solutions.text:
If there are \(3\) starters, then one person must not be starting. Choosing the person who doesn’t start determines the starters.

There are \(4\) choices for the person who doesn’t start.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Choosing the three starters is the same as choosing who sits out.
There are \(4\) possible players who could be the alternate.
